questions.question: what is your return policy?
questions.answer: You can return any item within 30 days of purchase with a valid receipt and original packaging.

questions.question: how long does shipping take?
questions.answer: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping takes 1-2 business days.

questions.question: do you ship internationally?
questions.answer: Yes! We ship worldwide. Shipping costs are calculated at checkout based on your location.

questions.question: how can I track my order?
questions.answer: Check your email for the shipping confirmation message containing your tracking link.
